title: ILPA Capital Call and Distribution Template
establishes: A standard notice format that fund managers send investors for each capital call and distribution.
why_included: Sets what a call or distribution must say to the investor.

title: ILPA Updates Capital Call and Distribution Template: Implications for GPs and LPs
establishes: How the current template splits a call by purpose (investments, fees, expenses) and a distribution by component (return of capital, gains, income, recallable amounts).
why_included: Gives the field-level content that the template page itself does not list.

title: ILPA Reporting and New Performance Template
establishes: The ILPA reporting and performance templates ask for fund cash flows, net asset value and investment-level cost and value.
why_included: Supports the investor's view of what is held and what it is worth.

title: ILPA Principles 3.0
establishes: Investor expectations for fund governance and transparency, including how commitments, follow-on investments by successor funds and cross-fund investments are disclosed.
why_included: Supports cross-fund exposure and the general partner commitment.

title: IPEV Valuation Guidelines
organisation: British Private Equity and Venture Capital Association
establishes: Industry guidelines for fair value measurement of private capital investments at a reporting date. The page establishes the guidelines' existence and scope only.
why_included: Supports valuation as at a date.

title: ASC 820 and private equity valuation
establishes: ASC 820 requires fair value to be classified in a three-level hierarchy according to the observability of its inputs.
why_included: Supports recording the hierarchy level beside each fair value.

title: A First Look at the CFA Institute's Final 2020 GIPS Standards
establishes: The 2020 GIPS standards apply to private market fund performance and rest on dated cash flows and valuations.
why_included: Supports performance being derived from dated cash flows and valuations.

title: Guidelines on reporting obligations under Articles 3(3)(d) and 24(1), (2) and (4) of the AIFMD
establishes: Alternative investment fund managers report to their regulator on each fund they manage, including master-feeder structures, domicile and principal exposures.
why_included: Supports recording fund domicile and feeder structures.

title: SEC Adopts Private Fund Risk Reporting (Form PF)
establishes: Private fund advisers report fund-level information to the SEC, including how funds are structured and invest through parallel and feeder funds.
why_included: Supports recording parallel and feeder funds.

title: Level 2 data: who owns whom
establishes: Level 2 data records the direct and ultimate accounting-consolidation parents of a legal entity identified by a legal entity identifier.
why_included: Supports recording ownership between identified entities and tracing to the ultimate parent.

title: Relationship record common data file format
establishes: A relationship between two identified entities is published with its start and end dates, a status and a relationship type.
why_included: Supports dated ownership relationships carrying a type and a status.

title: Private equity fund structure
establishes: A fund is a partnership managed by a general partner through a management company, and holds portfolio companies through holding vehicles.
why_included: Supports the shape of the sponsor and holding structure.

title: Parallel Fund Structures
establishes: Parallel funds invest side by side with a main fund on the same terms and in the same investments, and exist to meet the needs of particular investors.
why_included: Supports recording vehicles that invest alongside a fund.

title: Subscription Credit Facilities: Understanding Shared Blockers
establishes: A blocker is a corporate vehicle through which several investors, or several funds, may hold an investment.
why_included: Supports a holding vehicle shared by several investors.

title: Regulatory considerations for continuation funds
establishes: A continuation fund buys one or more assets from an existing fund of the same sponsor, and existing investors may sell or roll their interest.
why_included: Supports recording a transfer of a holding between two funds of one sponsor.

title: GP commitment in funds and SPVs
establishes: The general partner and its principals commit their own capital to the fund alongside outside investors.
why_included: Supports recording the general partner's own commitment as a commitment like any other.
